basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old from Austin, Texas, who recently picked up the guitar. Always been a fan of rock and blues, so I thought I'd give it a shot myself! Besides music, I'm a huge science fiction fan, especially anything by Brandon Sanderson. I work part-time as a barista and spend my evenings jamming away or diving into the latest sci-fi series. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm new to playing the guitar, mostly teaching myself through online tutorials and YouTube videos. My knowledge in music theory is basic, but I'm eager to learn more. I've got a decent grasp on tech-related stuff due to my interest in 3D printing, which I explore with my Ender 5 Plus printer.
